commands.reason.noworkspace: not in a workspace (press {shortcut} to create one)
commands.reason.besidelist: the detail is beside the list
commands.reason.running: a run is in progress ({shortcut} stops it)
commands.reason.norunpanel: no run is open in the panel
commands.reason.inrunpanel: a run is open (press Esc to go back to the project)
commands.reason.norecentfocus: the recent runs do not have the keyboard (press Tab)
commands.reason.inrecentfocus: the recent runs have the keyboard (press Tab to leave them)
commands.reason.nosidefocus: the detail does not have the keyboard (press Tab)
commands.reason.insidefocus: the detail has the keyboard (press Tab to leave it)
commands.reason.nosidenext: Tab does not go to the detail from here
commands.reason.sidenext: Tab goes to the detail from here
